title: In EPICS Base release 7.0.10 and prior, an improper validation of message length values during protocol parsing can…
description: EPICS Base versions 7.0.10 and earlier contain a vulnerability due to improper validation of message length values during protocol parsing. This flaw can cause an integer overflow leading to an out-of-bounds memory write. Exploiting this vulnerability may result in process instability or denial of service conditions.
